title: Router Helm Chart Values Schema
description: Schema for OpenTargets router Helm chart values

namespaceOverride.description: Existing namespace for proxies, or empty for <envPrefix>-<product>-router.

manageNamespace.description: Render the Namespace resource. Disable when another release owns it.

enabled.description: Render Ingress and its IP, DNS, certificates and FrontendConfig. Disable for proxies behind an existing Ingress.

gcpProject.description: The Google Cloud Project ID where the cluster lives.

product.description: The product name: either `platform` or `ppp`. Affects domain names, resource allocation, and configuration.

domain.description: The domain name where the application will be exposed.

dnsZone.description: The Google Cloud DNS zone name where the domain is managed.

enabled.description: Enable GKE BackendConfigs and NEG Services; frontend.enabled separately controls GCP frontend resources.

dns.description: When false, skips DNSRecordSet creation so the new path can be verified before DNS points at it.

dnsNamespaceOverride.description: Renders DNSRecordSets into this namespace instead of the release's own. Used to adopt pre-existing DNS records in place without moving them, since a namespace change requires delete+recreate.

dnsTargetOverride.description: Literal IP for A records instead of a live ComputeAddress reference (rrdatas instead of rrdatasRefs). Needed when adopting a record that was patched directly to a literal value during cutover, since the two are mutually exclusive.

stagingEnabled.description: The ApplicationSet passes this to platform to pause the non-prod colour; paused staging proxies use a process-only readiness probe.

replicas.description: Replica count for each nginx proxy Deployment. Defaults to 2 for zero-downtime rolling updates and PDB coverage.

names.description: Optional overrides to adopt pre-existing GCP resources instead of provisioning new ones.

computeAddress.description: Overrides the ComputeAddress (global static IP) name/resourceID. Default: <envPrefix>-<product>-computeaddress-global.

preSharedCerts.description: GCP SSL certificate resource names to bridge HTTPS during a migration, via pre-shared-cert.

rateLimiterWhitelist.description: CIDR blocks exempt from API rate limiting.
